measurement_basis: source inspection of the prior ambient diagnostic evidence payload and the authenticated campaign session context

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment ambient diagnostics evidence and read_evidence interface

outcome.observed_limitation: The durable diagnostic payload retained failures, outcomes, and witness references but did not carry related_work or recording_context. A consumer opening the evidence had to join it back to session state to identify the campaign objective and Environment that recorded it.
outcome.interpretation_limit: This establishes a missing relationship in the evidence contract; it does not establish that an agent was blocked or that the context was unavailable elsewhere.

related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence and Continuous Improvement, including capability accountability and machine-native adoption

pressure_hypothesis.title: Durable diagnostic evidence omits its originating work context
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment ambient diagnostics and session evidence
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Carry available campaign, session, Work Intent, Environment, consumer, and definition context in the existing durable diagnostic evidence payload. Omit unavailable fields instead of inventing them, and preserve failure and verification semantics.
not_measured: whether diagnostic consumers previously repeated session-context reconstruction
whether missing context affected an agent's interpretation or recovery
